description: An outer explicit image recipe suppresses its descendant's image recipe during the string walk. Sibling recipes each contribute their images, and values still concatenate all non-erased input parts (engine §11.1, §11.2).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [{part}]
%rule part letter | pause | mark
%rule letter "a" :: (L ∪ Sound-0061-s) := "a" | "b" :: (L ∪ Sound-0062-s) := "b" | "c" :: (L ∪ Sound-0063-s) := "c" | "d" :: (L ∪ Sound-0064-s) := "d" %emits $

%rule pause " " :: (P ∪ Sound-002E-s) := "." :- " " %emits $

%rule mark "!"
```
documents.h.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ($o:outer P $w:whole) %emits $o :: O, $w :: W

%rule outer :- $.verbatim-text | (inner L)

%rule inner :- $.verbatim-text | (L L)

%rule whole (inner inner) %emits $

```
